name: Gemini 338Lg
summary: Gemini 338Lg combines a stereo depth camera and IR bandpass filter with GMSL2 and FAKRA connectivity. It targets humanoids, mobile robots and robotic arms where flexible cabling and stable data transmission during motion are important. The IP65 camera also retains USB-C for development and supports synchronized depth, infrared, RGB and IMU streams.
